lead: Wednesday evening belonged to the labs and the diplomats: [Sam Altman and Dario Amodei are set to address the UN Security Council](../summaries/6e036c5b4b74.md) on AI, hours after [OpenAI said it will give its Daybreak cyber-defense system and GPT 5.6 Sol to Ukraine](../summaries/30bb23e1b34d.md) for free. Anthropic said [Claude autonomously discovered a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system](../summaries/246da2e2481d.md) as it stands up a life-sciences lab, and Google answered with [Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS models](../summaries/13123bf3c886.md) that direct custom voices from scratch. The agent wave kept rolling into products: [YouTube's Custom Feeds](../summaries/032f46ace773.md) steer the homepage with natural language, [Amazon opened its seller tools to Claude and its own Quick assistant](../summaries/9532e3c0f713.md), and [Rabbit launched OS3](../summaries/4c7cb941cc78.md), an agentic OS for every screen. Funding followed, with [Basecamp Research raising $140M](../summaries/5bdf05959460.md) joined by Anthropic's own fund and [Ema taking $77M](../summaries/dfb5bccbad7d.md) for enterprise 'AI employees'.
